# awscc_rds_deployment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::RDS::Deployment. Creates and manages an Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blue_green_deployment_name` (String) The name of the Blue/Green Deployment.
- `source` (String) The ARN of the source production database.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags assigned to the Blue/Green Deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `target_allocated_storage` (Number) The allocated storage size in GiB for the target DB instance.
- `target_db_cluster_parameter_group_name` (String) The DB cluster parameter group for the target Aurora DB cluster.
- `target_db_instance_class` (String) The DB instance class for target RDS DB instances.
- `target_db_parameter_group_name` (String) The DB parameter group for the target DB instance.
- `target_engine_version` (String) The DB engine version for the target database.
- `target_iops` (Number) The Provisioned IOPS value for the target DB instance.
- `target_storage_throughput` (Number) The storage throughput value for the target DB instance.
- `target_storage_type` (String) The storage type for the target DB instance.
- `upgrade_target_storage_config` (Boolean) Whether to upgrade the storage file system configuration on the target database.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Blue/Green Deployment.
- `blue_green_deployment_identifier` (String) The system-generated identifier of the Blue/Green Deployment.
- `create_time` (String) The time when the Blue/Green Deployment was created in UTC.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the Blue/Green Deployment.
- `switchover_details` (Attributes List) The source and target member mappings in the Blue/Green Deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--switchover_details))
- `target` (String) The ARN of the target database in the green environment.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) The provisioning tasks for the Blue/Green Deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--switchover_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `switchover_details`

Read-Only:

- `source_member` (String) The source database member in the Blue/Green Deployment.
- `switchover_detail_status` (String) The status of this source and target member pair.
- `target_member` (String) The target database member in the Blue/Green Deployment.


<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `task_name` (String) The name of a Blue/Green Deployment provisioning task.
- `task_status` (String) The status of a Blue/Green Deployment provisioning task.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_rds_deployment.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Blue/Green Deployment

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_rds_deployment.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_rds_deployment.example "arn"
```
